exposure: caesarean delivery or forceps in previous pregnancy
exaggerated sympathetic signs during pregnancy (perversion of taste and fatigue)
cohort: 150 Tunisian women were included in the first stage of the study, with 126 completing follow up at stage two.
finding: Post-partum depressive symptoms were common (14.7% at 1 week, 19.8% at 6-8 weeks postpartum) and correlated with quality of life.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery or forceps use in the previous pregnancy was associated with postpartum depressive symptoms.
